summary: A large HTTP 200 response was observed, which may indicate data exfiltration.
mitigations: Implement rate limiting for outbound HTTP requests.
Monitor for unusual outbound traffic patterns, especially to external IPs.
Enable server-side request forgery (SSRF) protection to restrict requests to internal resources.
Review and update firewall rules to restrict access to sensitive resources.
Regularly review and update server configurations to ensure they are secure against known vulnerabilities.
